issues.description: torch.cuda.set_device called with None when --local_rank not provided by launcher
issues.detail: In train.py the --local_rank default is None, then torch.cuda.set_device(args.local_rank) is called before deepspeed.init_distributed(). If the launcher doesn't pass --local_rank (DeepSpeed often uses LOCAL_RANK env var), this crashes immediately. Should fall back to int(os.environ.get('LOCAL_RANK', 0)).

issues.description: trainer_args key mismatch: 'max_step' vs documented 'max_steps' and missing val_interval
issues.detail: Docstring says trainer_args contains max_steps/val_interval, but code reads trainer_args['max_step'] and never uses val_interval. Validation runs every save_interval instead. Either fix the docstring or the keys; current state will confuse config writers and silently use wrong intervals.

issues.description: Checkpoint auto-resume scans output_dir even when resume_path is provided but missing
issues.detail: If user passes --resume_path pointing to a non-existent path, the trainer silently falls through to scanning output_dir/checkpoints and resumes from the latest. This masks user error. It should raise when an explicit resume_path doesn't exist rather than silently picking something else.

issues.description: Non-rank-0 ranks call wandb.log throughout training despite mode='disabled'
issues.detail: Every rank calls wandb.log in train()/valid(). For disabled mode this is a no-op but still introduces overhead and confusion. Worse, wandb.config.update at line 80 of trainer runs on all ranks before checking. Guard wandb calls with rank==0 or document the reliance on disabled-mode being truly silent.

issues.description: Validation iterator built without global_step/length kwargs may not match train factory signature
issues.detail: train() calls factory.build_iter(global_step=..., length=...) but valid() calls factory.build_iter() with no args. If DataIteratorFactory.build_iter has required args, valid breaks. If optional, validation may iterate the full dataset unexpectedly. Worth verifying and documenting expected behavior across train/valid.

issues.description: Argument naming inconsistency: --resume_path uses underscore while siblings use hyphens
issues.detail: All other flags use hyphens (--train-config, --output-dir, --wandb-name), but --resume_path uses an underscore. argparse exposes both via args.resume_path either way, but the CLI surface is inconsistent and harder to remember. Rename to --resume-path for consistency.

review.summary: The PR introduces a DeepSpeed-based trainer and launcher for SpeechLM. The main concerns are a likely crash when --local_rank isn't passed (default None into torch.cuda.set_device), a docstring/code mismatch on trainer_args keys (max_step vs max_steps, missing val_interval usage), and silent fallback when an explicit resume_path is missing. Several smaller issues around wandb usage on non-zero ranks, validation iterator signature, and CLI naming consistency should also be addressed before merge.
